title: Concourse vs. Trovata: How the Two Compare in 2026
summary: Concourse vs. Trovata compared: an AI agent that runs finance work end to end versus a modern multi-bank cash-visibility and forecasting platform. How they differ.
body_markdown:
Concourse and Trovata both connect to your banks and both talk about cash forecasting, so they end up on the same shortlist. But they are built to do different things. Trovata is a modern platform for *seeing* your cash: multi-bank aggregation, real-time reporting, and AI forecasting, in one place. Concourse is an AI agent platform for *doing* the finance work: agents that build the forecast, reconcile the accounts, and produce the reporting across your whole stack. The comparison comes down to that difference, and to how much of your finance function you want one tool to cover.


This is a focused, head-to-head look at the two. If you want the wider field of options, we also cover[Trovata alternatives](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/trovata-alternatives) separately.


## The short answer


> Concourse is the better fit if you want AI agents to run finance work end to end, forecasting, reconciliation, variance, and reporting, across treasury and the rest of finance, with every number traceable to source. Trovata is the better fit if you specifically want a dedicated, modern multi-bank cash-visibility and forecasting platform to work in. Because Concourse connects to your banks and ERP and runs the work, many teams use it in place of a dedicated cash platform, or on top of one.

## What Trovata is best at


Trovata is one of the strongest modern cash platforms on the market, and its core strength is connectivity. It is cloud and API-native, aggregating data across many banks automatically for real-time cash visibility and AI/ML forecasting, without the months-long implementation an enterprise TMS demands. After[acquiring ATOM in 2025](https://trovata.io/press/trovata-acquires-atom) it expanded into broader treasury coverage including debt, investments, FX hedging, and bank account management.


Its appeal is speed and modernity. A mid-market treasury team can get current, multi-bank cash visibility quickly, in a purpose-built system designed for exactly that. Trovata has[raised around $80 million, including a round from State Street and PNC](https://www.americanbanker.com/news/trovata-buys-treasury-software-fundraises-from-pnc-bank) , with customers including Square, Etsy, and Krispy Kreme. If what you want is a dedicated place to see and forecast cash across your banks, Trovata is built for it.


## What Concourse is best at


Concourse is an AI agent platform for corporate finance. It connects to your ERP, data warehouse, billing, and banking data and runs finance workflows autonomously or on triggers: building and refreshing cash forecasts, reconciling accounts, running variance and flux analysis, chasing receivables, and producing reporting, with a person approving before anything is final.


Two things set it apart from a cash-visibility platform. First, execution: Concourse does not just surface a cash dashboard for an analyst to interpret, its agents own the work end to end, and every output traces back to source data and is validated against evals built for your business. Second, breadth: Concourse is not limited to treasury. The same agents run FP&A, close, and collections work, so it can be one layer across the finance function rather than a point tool for cash. It meets teams in ChatGPT, Claude, Slack, Teams, and email, is SOC 2 Type II certified, and connects to 100+ systems including NetSuite, QuickBooks, Snowflake, Salesforce, and Stripe.


## Head to head, by what actually drives the decision


### Bank connectivity and cash visibility


This is Trovata's home turf. As a purpose-built, API-native cash platform, its multi-bank aggregation and real-time cash reporting are its reason to exist and are excellent. Concourse connects to your banks too, but pure, dedicated multi-bank cash visibility is Trovata's specialty. Advantage: Trovata, if a dedicated cash-visibility system of record is the goal.


### Cash forecasting


Both forecast cash. Trovata offers AI/ML forecasting inside its platform for a team to work with. Concourse deploys agents that build, refresh, and explain the forecast automatically, and run the variance behind it, with each figure traceable to source. If the bottleneck is the manual work of producing and defending forecasts, that is what Concourse is designed to remove. Advantage: Concourse.


### Execution and automation


This is the clearest split. Trovata gives your team a modern surface to see and analyze cash in; a person still does the work. Concourse's agents execute the work, from the forecast to the reconciliation to the report, under human approval. Advantage: Concourse.


### Breadth beyond treasury


Trovata is a treasury and cash-management platform by design. Concourse runs across the finance function, so the same agent layer that handles cash also handles variance analysis, collections, and reporting. If you want one tool for cash, Trovata fits; if you want one layer for finance, Concourse does. Advantage: Concourse for breadth.


## Can Concourse replace Trovata?


For most teams, yes. Concourse connects to your banks, ERP, and data warehouse and runs the forecasting, reconciliation, and reporting a cash platform is bought for, and it extends past cash into the rest of finance. Where Trovata still earns its place is as a dedicated, best-in-class multi-bank aggregation layer. Some teams keep Trovata for that connectivity and run Concourse for the analysis and execution on top; others connect Concourse to their banks directly and consolidate. Either way, replacing a point cash tool, rather than adding to it, is increasingly the default.


## Which should you choose?


- **Choose Concourse** if you want AI agents to *run* finance work, forecasting, reconciliation, variance, and reporting, across treasury and the rest of finance, with every number traceable and audit-ready.
- **Choose Trovata** if your specific need is a dedicated, modern multi-bank cash-visibility and forecasting platform for your team to work in.
- **Run both** if you want Trovata's multi-bank aggregation with Concourse doing the forecasting, analysis, and reporting on top, often as a step toward consolidating onto one layer.


## Frequently asked questions


### Does Concourse replace Trovata?


For most teams, yes. Concourse connects to your banks and ERP and runs the forecasting, reconciliation, and reporting work, and extends beyond cash into the rest of finance, so it can serve in place of a dedicated cash platform. Some teams keep Trovata as a multi-bank aggregation layer and run Concourse on top.


### Is Concourse a cash management platform like Trovata?


Not exactly. Trovata is a purpose-built cash-visibility and forecasting platform. Concourse is an AI agent platform that runs finance work, including cash forecasting and reporting, across your existing systems. Concourse does the work; Trovata is a place to see and analyze cash.


### Can Concourse and Trovata work together?


Yes. Concourse can run on top of the data an aggregation platform like Trovata centralizes, handling forecasting, variance, and reporting, or connect to your banks directly. Teams often start with both and later consolidate the work onto Concourse.


### Which is better for cash forecasting?


Both forecast cash. Trovata provides AI/ML forecasting for an analyst to work with; Concourse agents build, refresh, and explain the forecast end to end with every figure traceable to source. If you want the forecast produced and defended for you rather than built by hand, Concourse has the edge.


## The bottom line


Concourse vs. Trovata is not a like-for-like fight, because one is a place to see cash and the other is a way to do the work. Trovata is an excellent modern cash-visibility and forecasting platform. Concourse is an AI agent layer that executes the forecasting, reconciliation, and reporting, across treasury and the rest of finance, with every number defensible. If you are choosing between them, start from what you want: a dedicated cash dashboard points to Trovata; agents that run the work across your finance function point to Concourse.
